name: Rhubarb
definition: fresh or frozen rhubarb stalks (leaf stems), sold forced or field-grown, cooked with sugar.
reason: Sold under its own name; tart, not sweet as sold, so Vegetables (J-9); the eaten part is a stem, so Stems and shoots.

name: Okra [lady's finger, bhindi]
definition: fresh or frozen okra, the immature green seed capsule eaten whole.
reason: Generic type sold under its own name; a savoury botanical fruit, not a legume pod, so Fruiting vegetables (J-9).

name: Pumpkin and winter squash [winter squash]
definition: fresh or frozen pumpkin or winter squash, hard-rinded and eaten mature (butternut, kabocha, acorn, spaghetti); soft-skinned summer squash is courgette.
reason: No home: courgette covers only immature soft-skinned squash; pumpkin is sold under its own name, a savoury fruiting vegetable.
Winter squash goes to new J4.2.5.11; summer squash is J4.2.5.07 Courgette ('with squash of the same culinary use').

name: Mandarin [tangerine]
definition: fresh mandarin or tangerine other than clementine and satsuma, including mandarin hybrids sold as mandarins (Murcott, Nadorcott).
reason: Citrus is filed by shop and standard heading (memo 4b lists 'other mandarins'); clementine and satsuma leave other mandarins without a home.

name: Green bean [French bean, string bean]
definition: fresh or frozen immature bean pods eaten whole (French, runner, yardlong beans); dried beans are J5.

name: Oyster mushroom
definition: fresh oyster mushroom (Pleurotus), including king oyster.
reason: Mushrooms are kinds by market type (tree precedence); PLU sells it under its own name. J4.4 stays leafless (9 kinds, C5(b)).

name: Enoki
definition: fresh enoki mushroom (Flammulina), sold in clusters.
reason: Distinct market type with its own PLU code; no existing fungus kind covers it.

name: Morel
definition: fresh morel; dried morels are J5.
reason: Distinct wild market type with its own PLU code; chanterelle and truffle do not cover it.

name: Cep [porcini]
definition: fresh cep or porcini (Boletus edulis group); dried is J5.
reason: Own PLU code and its own UNECE Ceps standard (memo S4): the unit of standards, so a kind.
